strategy.name: 24h Momentum
strategy.rule: When the last trade is >= 3c away from the last trade a day ago (official previous_price field; market must be >= 24h old), buy that direction at the ask with a +2c limit; sell at a bid 5c above entry, else hold to settlement.
strategy.why: 24-hour momentum on the official tape. Fails when the last trade is stale or the move was a one-off print.
